scope: 80 existing exposed development problems; semantic helper alternatives and capture-checked scope/role naming. No new problem sources, protected access, training or runtime source generation.
source_policy: Preserve original interfaces, outputs and input effects. Avoid imported historical XOR-to-map and Array.from folds that add asymptotic memory. New naming checks reference-to-declaration identities before/after; native oracle qualification still required.
literal_policy: Full counted 96-entry ASCII/newline fallback. Flat exact strings only, no substitutions/hidden code. AST and contiguous spans may propose up to512bytes with at least two distinct problem owners; exclude whole solve functions and their complete bodies. No whole-solution entries.
comparison: Frozen scale-v2 and joint-v1 controls; source-only re-encoding, then actual-cost joint selection with AST candidates. Selections and complete package bytes separately.
acceptance: Keep only source variants passing all existing independent development cases and exact original output/input effects. Verify actual packet decoding, receipt hashes, fallback share and complete cost; no autonomous or heldout claims.
